about: Exclusively devoted to criminal defense law, Lawrence Zimmerman is the founder of his firm, Lawrence J. Zimmerman. He is known for excellence in protecting clients in Atlanta and throughout northern Georgia in matters involving fraud, felonies, misdemeanors, drug crimes and sex crimes.
In 1994, Mr. Zimmerman received a Bachelor of Arts in political science from the University of Florida. He then attended the Roger Williams University School of Law, earning a Juris Doctor in 1998.

From his days in law school, Mr. Zimmerman has had one focus: defending clients throughout the criminal process. At any point –– during an investigation, arrest or trial –– someone’s rights may be in jeopardy. Mr. Zimmerman is backed by decades of experience navigating each of these circumstances. He has appeared in state and federal courts on a client’s behalf.

Among his accomplishments, Mr. Zimmerman has been successul in acquitting or having charges dismissed against clients who have been charged with serious felony offenses including charges such as murder, sex offenses, and white collar crimes. While he handles all serious felony offenses, a large part of his practice is dedicated to representing those accused of sex crimes.

For his achievements and exceptional client service, Mr. Zimmerman holds an Avvo “Superb” rating. The Southern Center for Human Rights also presented him in 2018 with its Gideon’s Promise Award for his legal defense for the man falsely accused of burning the Atlanta interstate. He also received an Emmy Award for the Southeastern Region for some television work he did as part of a legal panel for 11 Alive News.

Mr. Zimmerman is a member of organizations such as the Georgia Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers where he is currently Vice-President and the National Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers. From 2015-2018 he also worked with the Atlanta Falcons security team.
